determinism: This manifest contains no wall-clock field. All timestamps derive from the committed pin, so re-running the ingester against the same pin reproduces this file byte for byte. Run time is recorded in reports/ingest.md.
integrity: This source carries no per-file sha256: per-file digests for the record count here would bloat the manifest past usefulness. Content integrity is instead anchored to two real digests -- the git commit SHA, which is itself a Merkle root over the entire tree, and records_digest, a SHA-256 over every record's content hash. Neither is synthesised, and no field claims to be a SHA-256 of something it is not.
